job.title: E-Commerce Developer (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt Shopify, Tracking und Conversion

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Headless APIs, Java, JavaScript
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, headless commerce, and JavaScript-based storefronts. Proven record designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines, and CI/CD deployments. Strong techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration, and agile team environments. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Developer (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt Shopify, Tracking und Conversion
cover_en.hook: I am excited by HPW Pharma’s commitment to natural health products and its growing portfolio of Shopify shops. With 5+ years building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless commerce, API development and data integration that directly supports conversion optimization.

bullets.label: Relevant Experience
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and delivered SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) backend and frontend features, handling product, catalog and pricing data for global B2B/B2C shops.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs, enabling seamless storefront and third-party integrations, similar to Shopify’s API-first approach.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring accurate product data flow across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business owners to translate requirements into user stories and functional specs, supporting production and UAT for high-traffic e-commerce sites.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, holding a valid German residence and work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026 and available from 16.12.2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als E-Commerce Developer (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt Shopify, Tracking und Conversion
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von HPW Pharma, hochwertige OTC-Produkte über mehrere Shopify-Shops zu vertreiben, begeistert mich. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how in Headless-Commerce, API-Entwicklung und Datenintegration mit, das die Conversion-Optimierung maßgeblich unterstützt.

bullets.label: Relevante Erfahrung
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Backend- und Frontend-Funktionen entwickelt und globale B2B- und B2C-Shops betreut.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Webservices und Headless-APIs, die nahtlose Storefront- und Drittanbieter-Integrationen ermöglichen – vergleichbar mit dem API-First-Ansatz von Shopify.

bullets.label: Integrations-Expertise
bullets.text: Ich baute PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub, um Produktdaten zuverlässig zwischen ERP- und MDM-Systemen zu synchronisieren.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Ich arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, übersetzte Anforderungen in User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen und unterstützte Produktion sowie UAT für stark frequentierte E-Commerce-Plattformen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Remote, Hybrid oder vor Ort möglich.

tailoring.why_company: HPW Pharma’s focus on natural health aligns with my passion for delivering user-centric digital experiences. Their multiple Shopify shops present a unique opportunity to apply my deep e-commerce integration expertise, improve tracking accuracy and boost conversion rates, while contributing to a brand that values quality and wellbeing. I am eager to help scale their online presence with robust, data-driven solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and API integration experience to enhance HPW Pharma’s Shopify ecosystem, improving tracking and conversion for their health-focused product range.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m excited about HPW Pharma’s Shopify portfolio and would love to discuss how my integration and API expertise can boost your conversion rates.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the E-Commerce Developer position. I bring over five years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, API development and data integration, and I am eager to contribute to HPW Pharma’s Shopify initiatives.

Kind regards,
